slots.hypothesis: The head inv(pow_3(pow_3(pow_3(LogFloatShares)))) is a monotone rewrite of the bare field. On the 5 rank-equivalent forms, rho_known is identical (-0.2945) and score is 0.47-0.50. After the LogFloatCap control, the residual is about -log(nominal price). The core is therefore the bare leaf, and family neutralization removes that level. The outside parts here are new; earlier forms were only power and inverse operators. There are three kinds: (1) share turnover with float shares as the denominator, i.e. log volume minus the core, over 5d / 20d / max / std and an Amt version (Mei-Scheinkman-Xiong 2004); (2) float-expansion events made continuous: the core minus its 120d rolling min, plus a small turnover-rank term so it passes the distinct gate, and turnover measured against the old (pre-expansion) float (Liu & Tang 2014; Ofek-Richardson 2000); (3) the float-share rank within cap deciles, multiplied by the cross-sectional rank of vol / MAX / turnover (Birru-Wang 2016). There are 15 seeds, all built with log-differences, rank products or bucket ranks. None is an additive blend, so the level term cannot swamp them and get them killed by the rank ban.

Scaling daily returns by the board's own price-limit width (Ret / LimitWidth) makes lottery-type and limit-hit features comparable across boards. The new axis is close to orthogonal to the float-share/nominal-price head, and the 5 controls do not cover it. There are 16 seeds: scaled MAX / MIN / std / asymmetry / decayed mean, soft counts of near-limit-up and near-limit-down days, intraday high-to-limit distance, upper shadow, next-day continuation, and MAX times abnormal amount. Two unscaled lottery measures are included as controls. GP picks the direction. Literature: Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011, Chen-Gao-He-Jiang-Xiong 2019, Wan et al. 2015, Kang-Shim 2014. Also drawn from PLAN §1(3).
